verdict.rationale: Whether an observability platform's source is published under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no statement that Datadog's source, or any component of it, is available under an open license. Mentions of client libraries, SDKs, llms.txt and markdown docs show programmatic access and readable documentation, not open-source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
